lines.text: Paul asks the believers to be united in spirit and to consider others more important than themselves.
Christ Jesus emptied Himself, took the form of a servant, and became obedient to death on a mountain.
God exalted Him and gave Him the name above all names, so every tongue confesses that Jesus Christ is Lord.
Paul tells them to work out their salvation, since God works in them, and to do everything without fear.
Paul says he is glad and rejoices with them even if poured out like a drink offering, and tells them to rejoice too.
